page_title: GEN 4-1 ROM | Genoa v AS Roma 28/09/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Daniele Orsato is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' AS Roma force a corner. They send men into the box.

90+2' That didn't go as planned! Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Josep Martinez, who easily kept it out.
90+2' Junior Messias (Genoa) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' Houssem Aouar (AS Roma) has tested the patience of referee Daniele Orsato and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
88' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) volleys the ball on the edge of the box after a rebound. It's a great effort and has Josep Martinez scrambling, but it flies just over the bar.

84' What an opportunity! Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) wastes a huge chance as he latches on to a perfect pass and produces a first-time blast from point blank range. It goes towards the bottom left corner, but Josep Martinez reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
84' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Paulo Dybala (AS Roma). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
81' 4 - 1 Goal Junior Messias (Genoa)! Junior Messias (Genoa) was put through by Morten Frendrup and he showed brilliant composure inside the box to fire into the bottom right corner. 4:1.
80' This shall not pass! Berkan Kutlu (Genoa) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
78' Here comes a substitution. Houssem Aouar (AS Roma) is brought on as a substitute for Leonardo Spinazzola.
78' A substitution has been made. Leandro Paredes goes off and Sardar Azmoun (AS Roma) comes on.
78' Here is a change. Lorenzo Pellegrini is going off and Jose Mourinho gives the last tactical orders to Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma).
77' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
76' The referee signals a substitution. Junior Messias (Genoa) is brought on as a substitute for Alan Matturro.
75' Mattia Bani (Genoa) picks up a yellow card for an infringement.
75' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) is punished with the yellow card.
74' 3 - 1 GOAL! The corner comes over and Radu Dragusin wins a simple header before Morten Thorsby (Genoa) nods the ball into the back of the net. 3:1.
74' Genoa will take a corner kick.
73' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 3:7. The current number of shots on goal is 2:1.
71' Berkan Kutlu (Genoa) fouls an opponent during an attacking move.

69' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) holds his head in his hands after missing a big chance. He latches on to a rebound, creates some space from himself and fires the ball from the edge of the box well wide of the right post.
67' Evan Ndicka (AS Roma) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Daniele Orsato saw the whole situation.
65' Mateo Retegui (Genoa) is shown a deserved yellow card for saying too much to the referee.

65' Mateo Retegui (Genoa) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Daniele Orsato with no other option than to blow for a foul. AS Roma win a free kick.
63' A rebound sits up nicely for Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) and he needs no second invitation to shoot from distance. The effort, however, slides well wide of the left post and out for a goal kick.
62' AS Roma fail to score from a corner as Josep Martinez (Genoa) leaps to collect the ball.
61' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
60' Corner kick. Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) is ready to send the ball into the box.
60' The corner kick from Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) is headed out of the penalty area by one of the defenders.
60' A cross from Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. AS Roma will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
56' Leonardo Spinazzola (AS Roma) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
54' Gooal! No wait, it's been ruled out for offside. Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) disagrees, but the linesman is sure about his call.
53' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Josep Martinez.
53' Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. AS Roma have a free kick.
51' The free kick from long range, taken by Genoa, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
50' A player from AS Roma takes his opponent down, the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) comes off for Andrea Belotti.
46' Alberto Gilardino has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Koni De Winter comes on the pitch for Stefano Sabelli (Genoa).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+7' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+7' Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma) sends a cross into the box, but Josep Martinez comes off his line to gather the ball.
45+5' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) makes a strong challenge and Daniele Orsato blows for a foul.
45+2' No handball! Referee Daniele Orsato points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. That prompts big celebrations from the Genoa players.
45+1' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was a handball in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Genoa players aren’t happy.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
45' 2 - 1 Goal - 2:1! Mateo Retegui (Genoa) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the top left corner. Morten Thorsby provided an assist for the goal.
44' Daniele Orsato blows his whistle after Berkan Kutlu (Genoa) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
42' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) commits a nasty foul by bringing down his opponent.
40' One of the players from AS Roma times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
37' The referee gives a yellow card to Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) for talking back. He must be careful for the remainder of the match.
37' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
35' Stefano Sabelli (Genoa) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
35' The total number of attempts is 1:3. The shots on goal statistics – 1:1.
34' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) and Rasmus Kristensen try to prise open the opposition with a series of short passes, but one of the defenders steps in and puts an end to the move.
30' Alberto Gilardino is forced to make a change. Kevin Strootman (Genoa) is unable to continue due to injury, Berkan Kutlu comes on.
30' It doesn’t look good for Kevin Strootman (Genoa); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
28' The free kick is delivered by Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
26' Kevin Strootman (Genoa) is shown a yellow card by the referee for a bad sliding tackle on an opponent.
26' Kevin Strootman (Genoa) makes a rough challenge and Daniele Orsato blows his whistle for a foul.
24' Diego Llorente (AS Roma) is being substituted because of an injury. Jose Mourinho sends Edoardo Bove on the pitch.
24' Diego Llorente (AS Roma) wants to continue but the body doesn’t look willing!
22' 1 - 1 Goal! Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) ran onto a clever lofted pass from Leonardo Spinazzola and easily beat the keeper with a header into the left side of the goal from close range. 1:1.
21' Gianluca Mancini finds Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) unmarked on the edge of the box, but his thunderbolt of shot goes high over the bar.
19' AS Roma players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
15' A long through ball into the box almost gives Mateo Retegui (Genoa) a good chance, but he loses out to one of the defenders.
12' Milan Badelj is substituted due to injury. Alberto Gilardino gives a chance to Morten Thorsby (Genoa).
10' Milan Badelj (Genoa) looks like he won’t be able to continue.
10' Kevin Strootman (Genoa) attempts to find Morten Frendrup, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
8' Leandro Paredes (AS Roma) picks up a rebound, moves into space and fires a shot at goal from long range that rises sharply and curls well wide of the right post.
8' AS Roma failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
7' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The linesman points to the corner flag, AS Roma are going to take it.

5' 1 - 0 Goal! Kevin Strootman displays great vision and sends a pass to Albert Gudmundsson (Genoa), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the bottom right corner. The score is 1:0.
3' Kevin Strootman (Genoa) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The match has just started.
AS Roma will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Daniele Orsato.
